decisions.reason: The partition and Unit 1 area allocation do not change the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The source changes the internal common-entrance partition and area allocation but does not alter retention or shared use of the existing main entrance.
The source does not address Unit 3 bathroom fixtures, drainage, shower placement, or bathroom partitions.
Adding 2.5 m² of common entrance area to Unit 1 does not necessarily change the Unit 1 toilet location or drain-alignment requirements.
The proposed wall follows a turquoise marking and remains consistent with the existing instruction to construct turquoise-marked partitions; no current wall-policy attribute is necessarily changed.
The added 2.5 m² changes Unit 1's spatial allocation but does not change its 2+1 configuration, bedroom count, or living-area count.
The common-entrance partition and area allocation do not change the open-plan kitchen configuration or cabinetry dimensions.
The source does not address Unit 2 bathroom placement, fixtures, drainage, or door position.
The marked blue and turquoise areas in the source concern the common entrance and Unit 1 allocation, not the Unit 3 kitchen counter or bathroom-door clearance.
The revised common-entrance allocation preserves the plan for three dwellings and does not change the dwelling count.
The source supplies a specific spatial-design change but does not alter the floor-plan deliverable, its format, or its required content categories.
The common-entrance and Unit 1 area change has no necessary effect on balcony retention or its enclosure condition.
